close_reason: healthy() gate in RoutingMailer, outbound_provider_healthy{provider} Prometheus gauge, start_health_poll() background task. All 601 tests pass.
description:
## Why this issue exists

Phase 4 of epic stoa-y0p2j. Add a background health-check task that periodically probes each configured OutboundMailer provider and updates its healthy() state. RoutingMailer skips unhealthy providers without attempting delivery.

## What needs to be done

1. Add healthy() -> bool to OutboundMailer trait (default impl returns true)
2. Add background task that periodically calls a health probe (noop for SMTP, provider health endpoint for HTTP APIs)
3. SmtpRelayMailer: delegates healthy() to PeerHealthState::has_healthy_peer()
4. Add Prometheus gauge: outbound_provider_healthy{provider} (0.0 or 1.0)
5. RoutingMailer.send() skips providers where healthy() = false before attempting
6. Tests: unhealthy provider is skipped; gauge is set correctly

## Acceptance criteria

- healthy() gate prevents delivery attempts to down providers
- outbound_provider_healthy{provider} gauge exported
- Background task interval configurable
- cargo test passes
title: Phase 4: provider health checking background task
